Completed Markdown step 12/12 after tasks 25-35 were finished and verified in order. Read this task and all three attached design scopes completely before implementation; earlier tasks likewise read only their own required specifications before starting. Added identical SQLite/text Markdown conformance, real concurrent stdio writes/deletes/replay, independent-clone association/binding/task/QA preservation, native combined acceptance and a 560,063-byte exact MCP -> editor -> MCP -> nearby architecture short -> full generated file round-trip. Critical audit found and fixed out-of-order document readback, post-delete projection diagnostics, editing during an in-flight Markdown save, and continued typing adopting a peer guard from a late dashboard readback. Added deterministic regression coverage for both save races.

Final rebuilt validation: npm run build and cargo build --bins succeeded; storage-api 13 tests passed; Rust library 228 passed, five existing live/manual tests intentionally ignored; versioned-draft regression passed; real SQLite/text MCP, adapter parity, 45 write-free reads, and 19 independent-Git-clone scenarios passed. Fresh native Tauri/WebView2 and MCP processes passed the same complete user path from both initial backends, including both conversion directions, toolbar/preview safety, conflicts and draft retention, reference navigation/deletion protection, import/source preservation, projection collisions/drift/retry/no-op, and full content retrieval. Large-document open/edit timings: 1711/630 ms and 1809/642 ms. Final Core evidence target/markdown-acceptance/d58aa61b-e79a-441d-ba51-23173ddd7d36; Native evidence target/markdown-acceptance/3b9e1bb3-f784-4469-8b89-84d2bf2ea75c. Adashi QA jobs 6/7 are green via runs 14/13. The installed QA host stalls nested Node/Python startup, so the suites execute through the workspace runner and those QA runs explicitly verify matching source/binary/log hashes and retain the output; earlier failures remain recorded. This is not a claim that the old QA host re-executed the whole suite.

Updated 13 formal owner descriptions from pending to implemented only for verified SQLite/text behavior. Server SQL remains unavailable/unvalidated and its tasks 20-23 full parity gate remains intact; no future-server capability is claimed. Canonical data remains selected-backend owned; generated Markdown remains one-way read output. Detailed report, exact binary hashes and reproducible commands: docs/markdown-validation.md. Fresh debug builds were tested in isolated fixtures; installed Program Files executables and the real project schema were not upgraded by the new build. Changes remain uncommitted. Final task-end audit and git diff --check passed.

Execution order: Markdown step 12 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 35 (Markdown 11/12 — Add controlled adoption of existing design Markdown). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Complete the feature with automated conformance and real desktop/MCP evidence after all preceding Markdown tasks pass. This gate covers currently implemented SQLite and text backends; future server SQL parity remains explicitly required by storage tasks 20-23.
Scope:
- Extend the common storage suite for complete bodies, identity, all read paths, schema/format upgrades, references/backlinks, tokens, no-op/replay, concurrent writes/deletes, atomic rollback, notifications and read-only byte/mtime/revision preservation.
- Cover SQLite/text conversion and independent-clone Git scenarios with Markdown, associations, bindings and task/QA links.
- Exercise real stdio MCP plus native Tauri/WebView2: create via MCP, discover/open in desktop, edit with the reused Markdown editor, preview, save, retrieve via MCP, follow a task/QA link, and read the full generated file from a nearby architecture short.
- Demonstrate fresh-token conflict resolution preserves drafts; deletion reports dependencies; rename preserves references; stale output/failure is visible; unchanged regeneration is write-free; imported sources stay intact.
- Include path ownership/collision handling, safe preview/link behavior, no silently truncated full documents, large-document responsiveness and bounded discovery payloads.
- Rebuild/reconnect the MCP process and test the real desktop build. Record evidence in QA jobs/runs and task completion, then update formal design status from pending to implemented only for verified behavior.
Acceptance:
- Every available backend passes the same domain contract and native/MCP user path. Existing C4/UML/mockup/task/QA workflows remain usable.
- Documentation, help, agent template and generated notice agree with the shipped API.
- List any unimplemented SQL capability explicitly and retain its acceptance gate in task 23; do not claim future-server validation.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications. The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.
